extracted.name: Almond Cookies
extracted.description: Chinese Almond cookies - great cookies for Chinese New Year - intense almond flavour Kitchen aid stand mixer - speed 2 for low speed Inspired by justonecookbook.com/almond-cookies/
instruction_lines: Mix dry ingredients using low speed.
Slowly pour in the oil as it mixes. You may need to increase the amount of oil if your dough is really crumbly. The dough is oily but should be solid enough to roll into a ball.
Line a pan with parchment paper.
Take about 1.5 teaspoon of dough and roll into a ball.
Place an almond in the center of the dough, pressing down a bit.
Beat the egg yolk and brush it on top of each cookie.
Bake for about 13-15 mins or until golden brown on top.
